# dictuzz — Benedictus Richard Ricardo

dictuzz.me is the professional portfolio and contact site of Benedictus Richard Ricardo, a Route-to-Market Analyst based in Bandung, Indonesia. His work focuses on route-to-market planning, reporting automation, operational governance, process design, and live operations.

## Selected work
- Reporting automation: A shared Excel workflow for finance, sales, and operations that reduced recurring manual reporting by more than 12 hours per week.
- KPI governance: Operating routines and accountability structures for a 34-member student council across 10 divisions.
- Event operations: Coordination for live events with more than 1,000 attendees.
- Technical readiness: Equipment maintenance and training support for field operations.
